paper_id: Knowledge-Aware Conversational Semantic Parsing Over Web Tables
title: Knowledge-Aware Conversational Semantic Parsing Over Web Tables
motivation: 当前方法在处理对话式表格问答时缺乏知识获取和推理能力,无法有效处理co-reference和ellipsis现象
problem_framing: 将对话式表格问答建模为语义解析任务,把用户话语映射为可执行的逻辑形式(SQL)
key_insight: 通过整合三类知识(语法知识用于复制先前逻辑形式,专家知识用于模块化设计,外部资源知识用于增强表示)来提升解析性能
method_signature: CAMP:知识感知的模块化语义解析器,通过copy actions处理上下文依赖
evaluation_criteria: 在SequentialQA数据集上的准确率,包括整体准确率和序列准确率
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 错误主要由error propagation和semantic matching problems及grammar limitation引起,当前grammar不覆盖contains in操作符
evidence_for_taste: a decomposable model is more controllable
grammar knowledge empowers the model to effectively replicate
Spurious logical forms could be executed to get the correct answer
The errors are mainly caused by error propagation
Pruning logical forms is vital for improving model performance
thinking_moves: 将端到端模型改为模块化可解释架构,增强可控性
通过引入copy actions主动利用对话历史解决ellipsis问题
从错误案例反推系统局限:error propagation, semantic matching, grammar coverage
用ablation study验证各类知识的增量贡献
设计pruning策略去除spurious logical forms,改善训练信号质量
